name: GRT-BVW 21 Limbourg - Clermont-sur-Berwinne
description_md:
This waymarked hiking route is designated as GRT-BVW 21 Limbourg to Clermont-sur-Berwinne and features the signpost code BVW. It is part of the national waymarked hiking network in Belgium, covering a distance of 79.2 km with 1473 m of ascent and 1449 m of descent.

The difficulty is hard, derived from the distance and ascent, requiring about 24 hours on the DIN 33466 hiking time rule. The route passes drielandenpunt within 100 m, Vaalserberg within 100 m, and Bildchen within 1400 m.
